profile.subtitleJa: 古代エジプトの王を指す称号。
profile.summaryJa: 列王記上3:1では、エジプトの王ファラオとソロモンの間で婚姻による同盟が結ばれます。
profile.identityNoteJa: 「ファラオ」は個人名ではなくエジプト王の称号。列王記上の複数用例が同じ統治者を指すとは限らない。

facts.textJa: ソロモンはファラオの娘を妻に迎え、婚姻同盟を結びます。
ソロモンは、妻として迎えたファラオの娘のためにも家を建てます。
ファラオの娘がダビデの町からソロモンの建てた家へ移ると、ソロモンはミロを建てます。
タフペネスは、ファラオの家で育ったゲヌバトを生みます。この節のファラオを3:1の王と同一視する情報は本文にありません。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her into David’s city until he had finished building his own house, the LORD’s house, and the wall around Jerusalem.
His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.
But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.
The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.
